arxiv-1912-02569.title: Beyond the Standard Models
arxiv-1912-02569.creator: with Cosmic Strings
arxiv-1912-02569.description:
A 2019 arXiv research paper by with Cosmic Strings. DESY 19-204

Abstract

We examine which information on the early cosmological history can be extracted from the potential measurement by third-generation gravitational-wave observatories of a stochastic gravitational wave background (SGWB) produced by cosmic strings. We consider a variety of cosmological scenarios breaking the scale-invariant properties of the spectrum, such as early long matter or kination eras, short intermediate matter and inflation periods inside a radiation era, and their specific signatures on the SGWB.

arxiv-2103-08069.title: Binary R Packages for Linux: Past, Present and Future
arxiv-2103-08069.creator: by Iñaki Ucar, Dirk Eddelbuettel
arxiv-2103-08069.description: Abstract Pre-compiled binary packages provide a convenient way of efficiently distributing software that has been adopted by most Linux package management systems. However, the heterogeneity of the Linux ecosystem, combined with the growing number of R extensions available, poses a scalability problem.

arxiv-2106-08950.title: A diffuse-interface lattice Boltzmann method for fluid-particle interaction problems
arxiv-2106-08950.creator: Jiao Liu, Changsheng Huang, Zhenhua Chai, Baochang Shi
arxiv-2106-08950.description: Abstract In this paper, a diffuse-interface lattice Boltzmann method (DI-LBM) is developed for fluid-particle interaction problems. In this method, the sharp interface between the fluid and solid is replaced by a thin but nonzero thickness transition region named diffuse interface, where the physical variables varies continuously.

arxiv-2112-03808.title: Automated Story Generation as Question-Answering
arxiv-2112-03808.creator: Louis Castricato, Spencer Frazier, Jonathan Balloch, Nitya Tarakad, Mark O. Riedl
arxiv-2112-03808.description: Abstract Neural language model-based approaches to automated story generation suffer from two important limitations. First, language model-based story generators generally do not work toward a given goal or ending. Second, they often lose coherence as the story gets longer. We propose a novel approach to automated story generation that treats the problem as one of generative question-answering.

arxiv-2112-05073.description: Abstract Classical Be stars are possible products of close binary evolution, in which the mass donor becomes a hot, stripped O or B-type subdwarf (sdO/sdB), and the mass gainer spins up and grows a disk to become a Be star.

arxiv-2206-06735.title: V-shaped action functional with delay
arxiv-2206-06735.creator: Urs Frauenfelder
arxiv-2206-06735.description: Abstract In this note we introduce the V-shaped action function with delay in a symplectization which is an intermediate action functional between Rabinowitz action functional and the V-shaped action functional. It lives on the same space as the V-shaped action functional but its gradient flow equation is a delay equation as in the case of Rabinowitz action functional.

arxiv-2208-12152.title: Supervised Dimensionality Reduction and Image Classification Utilizing Convolutional Autoencoders
arxiv-2208-12152.creator: Ioannis A. Nellas, Sotiris K. Tasoulis, Vassilis P. Plagianakos, Spiros V. Georgakopoulos
arxiv-2208-12152.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Ioannis A. Nellas, Sotiris K. Tasoulis, Vassilis P. Plagianakos, Spiros V. Georgakopoulos. The joint optimization of the reconstruction and classification error is a hard non convex problem, especially when a non linear mapping is utilized. In order to overcome this obstacle, a novel optimization strategy is proposed, in which a Convolutional Autoencoder for dimensionality reduction and a classifier composed by a Fully Connected Network, are combined to simultaneously produce supervised dimensionality reduction and predictions.

arxiv-2501-06951.title: Rigidity Results Involving Stabilized Scalar Curvature
arxiv-2501-06951.creator: Yipeng Wang
arxiv-2501-06951.description: Abstract . We establish a rigidity theorem for Brendle and Hung’s recent systolic inequality, which involves Gromov’s notion of T ⋊ T^{\rtimes} -stabilized scalar curvature. Our primary technique is the construction of foliations by free boundary weighted constant mean curvature hypersurfaces, enabling us to generalize several classical scalar curvature rigidity results to the T ⋊ T^{\rtimes} -stabilized setting.

arxiv-2508-02006.title: Exact algorithms for quadratic optimization over roots of unity
arxiv-2508-02006.creator: Ahmad Al-Sulami, Hamza Fawzi, Shengding Sun
arxiv-2508-02006.description: Abstract We consider the problem of optimizing a multivariate quadratic function where each decision variable is constrained to be a complex m m ’th root of unity. Such problems have applications in signal processing, MIMO detection, and the computation of ground states in statistical physics, among others. Our contributions in this paper are twofold.

arxiv-2510-16691.title: Abundance Analysis of Chemically Depleted Post-AGB/Post-RGB Binaries with Faint Discs DOI: ZZZZZ
arxiv-2510-16691.creator: Maksym Mohorian, Devika Kamath, Meghna Menon, Hans Van Winckel, Mingjie Jian, Anish M. Amarsi, Kateryna Andrych
arxiv-2510-16691.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Maksym Mohorian, Devika Kamath, Meghna Menon, Hans Van Winckel, Mingjie Jian, Anish M. Amarsi, Kateryna Andrych. Post-AGB and post-RGB binaries with stable circumbinary discs provide key insights into late stellar and disc evolution, revealing how binary interactions shape disc structure and stellar surface composition. A defining trait of such systems is the observed underabundance of refractory elements in the stellar photosphere relative to volatile elements – photospheric chemical depletion – resulting from the star accreting volatile-rich circumstellar gas.

pmc-10733950.title: Electrostatic Nanocage-Confined Probe for Electrochemical Detection of CA19-9 in Human Serum
pmc-10733950.creator: Yucheng Zhou, Xuan Luo, Fei Yan, Yiping Mou
pmc-10733950.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Prompt and accurate detection of CA19-9 in human serum has great clinical significance for the early diagnosis and disease monitoring of cancer. pmc-11318286.creator: Alexis McGill, Vahid Salehi, Rose McCloskey, Doug Smith, Brian Veitch
pmc-11318286.description: BackgroundHealthcare system sustainability is challenged by several critical issues; one of the most pressing is the ageing population. Traditional, episodic care delivery models are not designed for older people who are medically complex and frail. These individuals would benefit from health and social care that is more comprehensive, coordinated, person-centred and accessible in the communities in which they live.

pmc-11685197.title: The role of microglia in Neuroinflammation associated with cardiopulmonary bypass
pmc-11685197.creator: Lingda Meng, Tianxiang Gu, Peng Yu, Zhiwei Zhang, Zhijing Wei
pmc-11685197.description: Cardiopulmonary bypass (CPB) and deep hypothermic circulatory arrest (DHCA) are indispensable core techniques in cardiac surgery. Numerous studies have shown that cardiopulmonary bypass and deep hypothermic circulatory arrest are associated with the occurrence of neuroinflammation, accompanied by the activation of microglia. Microglia, as macrophages in the central nervous system, play an irreplaceable role in neuroinflammation.

pmc-12537727.title: The vaginal microbiome in HPV persistence and cervical cancer progression
pmc-12537727.creator: Jhommara Bautista, Adriana Altamirano-Colina, Andrés López-Cortés
pmc-12537727.description: Persistent infection with high-risk human papillomaviruses (HR-HPV) is the primary cause of cervical cancer, but its progression depends on host and environmental factors beyond viral presence.
